(1) Yes, it has a purple (or violet) border/glow on its top edge.
(2) Left of GENERATE: an open padlock icon. Right of GENERATE (in order): a "x1" chip with a right chevron/arrow; a settings/sliders icon. In the controls row below: the OFF chip contains a robot/AI head icon with sparkles; next to the word "High" is a diamond or rhombus shape icon.
(3) Yes, there is a hamburger menu icon (three horizontal lines) at the right end of the pill after the word Video.
